name: dev-flow
description: A guided 11-step pipeline that drives a feature or fix end-to-end — brainstorm → spec → plan → GitHub issue → TDD execution → fresh-subagent test and review gates → PR. Resumable via gitignored state files with a hard status gate so no step is ever skipped or reordered. Fully self-contained: every step runs its own in-house skill, no external plugin dependencies. Works standalone in any repo.
